changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries, normalized dataset names (NLTK words/library → NLTK), normalized model naming (Phi 3 → Phi-3), and improved output descriptions for clarity. Added missing multilingual languages mentioned in the paper.
Consolidated metric variants under 'Accuracy'. 'Soft match' is a variant of Accuracy measurement used for Task II, not a separate metric.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs were only used as generation models.
No human evaluations were conducted in this study. All evaluations were automatic using accuracy metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on analyzing LLM failures on simple word-based counting tasks and evaluates various strategies to improve performance. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and consolidation of duplicates. The paper evaluates generation capabilities (counting answers) but doesn't use LLMs as judges or conduct human evaluations.
